create_ddp_model: create a DistributedDataParallel model from a torch module with optional fp16 compression hooks
build_default_argument_parser: build an argparse parser with common detectron2 training arguments like config file, resume, and eval-only
run_default_setup: run default setup to configure logging, environment info, config backup, and random seed for training
create_default_predictor: create a DefaultPredictor that loads a model checkpoint and runs inference on a single BGR image
train_default_trainer: train a model using DefaultTrainer with resume, checkpointing, evaluation hooks, and auto-scaled worker config
